standard_artifact_reuse.validation: artifact, generator source, dataset provenance, and normalization matched

distinguishability.note: detectability_auc=max(raw_auroc, 1-raw_auroc): 0.5 means chance-level separation (good fidelity); 1.0 means trivially separable (poor fidelity).

downstream_utility.note: Primary downstream metrics are in downstream_utility_models (ML models + augmentation + tail learnability).

tail_learnability.delta_tail_definition: M(real->real) - M(arm->real) on higher-is-better metrics; >0 means that arm loses tail signal. delta_tail: synthetic; delta_tail_augmented: real+synthetic; delta_tail_tail_targeted: tail-oversampled synthetic; delta_tail_tail_targeted_augmented: real+tail-oversampled synthetic. *_ci are percentile bootstrap CIs.

downstream_utility_tasks.note: Fixed-prefix early behaviour -> future-only outcomes; delta = M(real)-M(synthetic), >0 = synthetic loses signal. Recovery is evaluated only among learners whose observed prefix shows failure, and its label is determined exclusively by later responses. All *_ci fields are 95% percentile learner-bootstrap intervals; delta intervals use paired resamples of the common held-out real learners.

persistent_failure_prediction.eligibility_definition: All learners with enough post-prefix interactions.
persistent_failure_prediction.outcome_definition: Mean correctness after the fixed prefix is at or below the training-fitted low-correctness cutoff.
persistent_failure_prediction.relationship_to_tail_analysis: Related to persistent failure, but distinct from the whole-trajectory tail-group label.

recovery_prediction.eligibility_definition: Correctness in the fixed prefix is at most 0.35.
recovery_prediction.outcome_definition: Mean correctness after the fixed prefix is at least 0.65.
recovery_prediction.relationship_to_tail_analysis: Related to recovery, but distinct from the half-vs-half tail-group label.

evaluation_sampling.note: Rare-group fidelity, primary downstream models, and explicit outcome tasks use complete frames; memory-heavy diagnostics use the recorded whole-learner samples.

comparison.direction: Positive values mean tail-targeted generation increased empirical privacy risk.

by_tail_group.note: real_tail->synthetic NN; lower distance / higher membership AUC than the non-tail baseline = privacy-tail conflict.
real_tail->synthetic NN; lower distance / higher membership AUC than the non-tail baseline = privacy-tail conflict.

excluded_from_publication.diversity_uniqueness_rates: Novelty is not monotonic quality; retained only in the raw diagnostic report.
excluded_from_publication.fixed_threshold_classification_scores: Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 at an untuned 0.5 threshold are diagnostics only.
excluded_from_publication.lightweight_downstream_utility: Skill-mean smoke test; superseded by the declared HGB model.

omitted_standard_tail_groups.long_trajectory: Shared trajectory-length sampler; not attributable to the generator model.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.persistent_failure: Rare-group prevalence is retained, but trajectory shape is not estimable because fewer than 10 real or synthetic tail learners are available.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.persistent_misconception: Real-train learner prevalence 0.306504 exceeds the rare-group ceiling 0.100000.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.rapid_guessing: Rare-group prevalence is retained, but trajectory shape is not estimable because fewer than 10 real or synthetic tail learners are available.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.short_trajectory: Shared trajectory-length sampler; not attributable to the generator model.

omitted_tail_learnability_groups.long_trajectory: Shared length-sampler group; excluded from generator comparison.
omitted_tail_learnability_groups.persistent_misconception: Real-train learner prevalence 0.306504 exceeds the rare-group ceiling 0.100000.
omitted_tail_learnability_groups.short_trajectory: Shared length-sampler group; excluded from generator comparison.

omitted_targeted_tail_groups.long_trajectory: Shared trajectory-length sampler; not attributable to the generator model.
omitted_targeted_tail_groups.persistent_failure: Rare-group prevalence is retained, but trajectory shape is not estimable because fewer than 10 real or synthetic tail learners are available.
omitted_targeted_tail_groups.persistent_misconception: Real-train learner prevalence 0.306504 exceeds the rare-group ceiling 0.100000.

omitted_targeted_tail_groups.short_trajectory: Shared trajectory-length sampler; not attributable to the generator model.

excluded_from_publication.raw_diagnostic_aggregates: Unfiltered all-column marginals/NMI, detector accuracy, and minimum-NN extremes are not table metrics.
excluded_from_publication.raw_membership_auc_inversion: An AUC below 0.5 is not inverted into privacy leakage; publication advantage is max(0, 2*(AUC-0.5)).
excluded_from_publication.raw_test_fidelity_duplicates: Held-out real data is reserved for downstream generalization; primary fidelity is against real train.
excluded_from_publication.sequence_length_model_ranking: All generators use the same trajectory-length sampler, so length metrics are pipeline diagnostics.
excluded_from_publication.short_and_long_trajectory_tails: Shared length sampler prevents attribution to a generator architecture.
excluded_from_publication.threshold_metric_deltas: Only AUPRC/AUROC utility gaps are publication metrics.

research_question_mapping.rq1: Average, temporal, dependence, subgroup, and rare-pathway preservation.
research_question_mapping.rq2: Held-out-real utility, tail learnability, targeting gains, and privacy risk.
